title: Labor Rate Discount Locked at Signature: Calculation for Professional Services Projects
content:
A time-and-materials statement of work of Professional Services Projects is signed at the class list rates (the technician, senior engineer and solutions architect hourly rates of the engagement's class on the time-and-materials rate card), and the rate discount locked at signature on those list rates is 0.0 percent.

## How the locked discount is stated

The rate discount locked at signature is a percentage figured from the client's records as they stand on the signature date. Where it is made up of more than one percentage, each is figured on its own from those records and none is figured on another; they are added together, and the total is rounded half up to one decimal place once, after the addition.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Date of the records read | the signature date |
| Rates the discount applies to | the class list rates |
| Discount on the list rates | 0.0 percent |
| Combination | percentages added together, none figured on another |
| Rounding | half up to one decimal place, once, after the addition |

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

- The list rates of the class are signed with a locked discount of 0.0 percent.
- Two percentages of, hypothetically, 1.05 and 0.4 add to 1.45, which rounds half up to 1.5.
- Three percentages of, hypothetically, 2.0, 0.25 and 0.5 add to 2.75, which rounds half up to 2.8.
